In Europe it has been replaced since 2016 by the GSE FireFly engines; in Brazil the 1.0 Fire comes out of production with the Proconve L8 regulations of 2025.

ferrari-f113.storia: Twelve countertop cylinders mounted longitudinally behind the cockpit, above the gearbox, with the same alesing and running measures (82 x 78 mm) of the F110A of the 512 BBi. Ferrari calls it boxer, but the opposite cylinder rods work on the same crank pin: technically it is a V at 180°. Compared to its predecessor, it introduces four valves per cylinder; the 512 TR adopts Bosch Motronic management, camshafts, collectors and revised valves, the F512 M lightened motor shaft and titanium biella.
ferrari-f113.iniezione: Bosch K-/KE-Jetronic, then Bosch Motronic M2.7
punti_deboli: Water and oil pump chain: updated in 1987, to be mounted on the previous Roofs
Carbon deposits if the engine is not regularly brought to the high regimes
curiosita: The F512 M was produced in 501 specimens, 75 of which for North America.
The Testarossa (all variants) were built 9939 units.

in_breve.testo: lubrication on all versions
in the F512 M, with titanium biella and lightened tree

ferrari-f120.storia: V8 to 90° biturbo mounted longitudinally, derived from the eight-cylinder valves of the 308. On the 288 GTO (F114B) the displacement drops to 2855 cc reducing the allotment, to remain within the limit of equivalent displacement of Group B; on the F40 (F120A) climbs to 2936 cc with alesaggio 82 mm (81.9 in the Ferrari data) and race 69,5 mm, with higher maximum regime. Two water-cooled IHI turbochargers with Behr air/air intercoolers, Weber-Marelli integrated injection and ignition, dry-carter lubrication.
ferrari-f120.limiti: With increased oversupply pressure and discharge the F40 significantly exceeds the 550–600 CVs; the F40 Competition reached 700 CVs with turbo and specific interiors. On road engines the limit is the standard turbos and the Weber-Marelli management.
punti_deboli: Distribution belts: periodic replacement at short and costly intervals
curiosita: The 288 GTO Evoluzione, built in six specimens since 1986, uses a version of the same engine from about 650 CVs.
The F40 was built in 1311 specimens, without catalyst until 1990.

in_breve.testo: oversupply pressure of the two water cooled IHI turbos
specific power of F40
displacement of 288 GTO, fixed by FIA coefficient for turbo engines in Group B

affidabilita.motivo: Belts at short intervals; limited production.

ferrari-f133.storia: V12 65° designed ex novo for the 456 GT (sign F116) to replace the 60° derived from the 412 Colombo, with base and head in light alloy, barrels with Nikasil carry, four camshafts and dry-carter lubrication. With the 550 Maranello of 1996 becomes F133, it loses the hydraulic tips and adopts a suction manifold with variable length with twelve butterflies. Since 2002 the displacement has risen to 5748 cc (89 x 77 mm) for 575M, Superamerica and 612 Scaglietti; the successor is the F140 family.
ferrari-f133.blocco: Light alloy, rods with Nikasil carry
punti_deboli: Valve guides on 456 and 550: wear with increased oil consumption, reported by specialists
Overheating in case of faulty electrovental
curiosita: Of the 550 Pininfarina Barchetta 448 were built, with the same power as the coupe.

in_breve.testo: corner between the banks, instead of the 60° of the V12 derivation Colombo
lubrication for low mounting in front compartment
International Engine of the Year award over 4 liters for 5.5

affidabilita.motivo: Oil, valve guides and belts: demanding maintenance.

ferrari-f131.storia: V8 at 90° with flat motor shaft and dry carter lubrication, engine evolution of 348 with new five-valve cylinder heads and stroke of 75 to 77 mm on F355 (F129B, 3496 cc). In 1999, 360 Modena adopted the F131B version of 3586 cc (85 × 79 mm), with variable beaming on the exhaust and management trees Bosch Motronic ME 7.3 with electronic accelerator. In 2004 he was replaced by the F136 of the F430. The indicated displacement is that of 360.
ferrari-f131.limiti: Suctioned high-rise motor with reduced margins without internal interventions. The Challenge Stradale indicates the result obtained from the factory without overcharging: 425 CV with 11,2:1 compression, polished ducts, increased suction and double flow discharge. On the F355 the critical component for prolonged use at high level are the valve guides.
punti_deboli: F355 exhaust collectors subject to cracks; if neglected can damage the engine
Bronze valve guides of the F355 subject to early wear, often replaced in advance
Exhaust bypass valves that wear and vibrate at a minimum
curiosita: The F355 acronym indicates the displacement of 3.5 liters and the 5 valves per cylinder.
The F355 biella are forged in Ti6Al4V titanium alloy.

in_breve.testo: cylinder valves on F355 and 360
maximum speed of 360 Modena and Challenge Stradale
in the 360 Challenge Road, compression 11,2:1

affidabilita.motivo: F355 collectors and valve guides with frequent faults.

lamborghini-v12-bizzarrini.limiti: Suctioned motor: series versions arrive at 670 CV with 6.5 liters and increases were obtained with displacement and regime. The critical component is chain distribution, with tensioners and phase variators sensitive to the quality and state of oil.
lamborghini-v12-bizzarrini.distribuzione: DOHC chain, variable slot on the latest versions
lamborghini-v12-bizzarrini.iniezione: Weber carburetors, then indirect multipoint (from Diablo)
punti_deboli: Countach: registration of the valve game every 15,000 miles with carburetors removal
Diablo: oil leaks from the sealant between base and cup; phase variators of the latest oil-sensitive versions
curiosita: The displacement passes from 3.5 liters of 350 GTV to 6496 cc of Murciélago LP640, almost doubling.
The four-valve V12 of the Countach Quattrovalvole also features the LM002 off-road.

from 350 GTV to the last Murciélago

lamborghini-v10-50.limiti: The series comes at 530 CV with 510 Nm. The critical component is the biella bronzine: oversupply and prolonged use to the limiter caused the failure, especially on the engines built before 2005.
lamborghini-v10-50.distribuzione: DOHC chain, continuous variable milling on suction and exhaust
punti_deboli: weakest biella bronzes on the first engines built in Germany (up to around 2005)
Oil leaks from the rear oil of the motor shaft, to be replaced together with the clutch
Butterfly bodies that glue on used cars especially in the city

in_breve.testo: lubrication derived from sports use
in the Gallardo Superleggera at 8000 rpm

maserati-biturbo-v6.blocco: Aluminium (wet barrel with Nikasil carry on 2.0)
punti_deboli: Surheating on the first carburetor engines
Distribution belt with a range of about 38,000 km (24,000 miles)
Oil threads in the back of the engine and water pump with game

maserati-f160.limiti: The most powerful series releases 430 CV and 580 Nm. Further increases on turbochargers and distribution chains, whose state depends on oil exchange intervals.
maserati-f160.distribuzione: DOHC chain, roller balancers with hydraulic props
punti_deboli: Housing of plastic thermostat that deforms and cracks, with cooling liquid losses
Use of hydraulic tensioners of distribution chains, aggravated by long oil exchange intervals (cold mood)

between banks, unlike the V8 F154 at 90°

bmw-m20.storia: Six single-seater two-valve cylinders introduced in 1977 on E12 520/6 and E21 320/6, more compact than the M30: cylinders reduced from 100 to 91 mm and inclination in the compartment from 30° to 20°. Base in closed-deck cast iron with siamese rods, tested in aluminium with cross-flows and distribution belt. The 2.7-litre version, with a 81 mm stroke and a 4800 rpm limiter, was developed for couple to low rates and reduced consumption, even according to US CAFE limits. Since 1990 it has been replaced by the M50 to four valves.
bmw-m20.limiti: In aspiration the limit is the two-valve test: the 325i header and eta base of 2.7 liters leads to about 200 CV, with oil pump of 325i because that eta has lower flow rate. Superpower thresholds not documented by the manufacturer.
bmw-m20.distribuzione: SOHC with toothed belt, barbeques with eccentric logs
bmw-m20.iniezione: Carburetor (prime 2.0), then indirect K-, L-, LE-Jetronic and Motronic
punti_deboli: Distribution belt: interfering motor, breakage damages valves and test; it must be replaced for mileage and age
Air flow meter, minimum valve and vacuum tubes on dated specimens
curiosita: From the M20 comes the six M21 diesel cylinders of 524td.

in_breve.testo: cylinder interassess, against the 100 mm of the six-cylinder M30
belt distribution instead of the chain, for noise and lower costs
rpm of limiter on 2.7 litres eta versions, oriented to torque below

affidabilita.motivo: Interference strap and head cracks after overheating.

bmw-m30.limiti: The cast iron base with forged shaft has set the superpower of 745i (252 CV) and, in the Alpine B10 Biturbo with forged pistons, 360 CV. The critical component is the aluminum head, sensitive to overheating. Undocumented limiter: the indicated value is the maximum rounded power system.
punti_deboli: Aluminium head: deformation for overheating; cracks documented above all on pre-1980 units
Cooling: viscous fan joint, radiator and water pump on dated specimens
Oil leaks from tip cover and cup; game valves to record periodically
curiosita: The last 50 M30 bases were intended for Alpina for the last 50 B10 Biturbo.

in_breve.testo: debut year; over 25 years of production, the BMW engine built longer
turbo version with KKK K27 and 745i intercooler (E23), first six BMW turbo cylinders
on seven bench supports in cast iron base

affidabilita.motivo: Robust; cooling defects on dated specimens.

bmw-m50-m52.limiti: In oversupply the cast iron base of the M50, with reinforced head prisoners and specific seal, is indicated for about 400 CV with series interiors. For the aluminium base M52 there are no documented thresholds.
bmw-m50-m52.distribuzione: Chain DOHC; VANOS intake since 1992, double VANOS on M52TÜ
bmw-m50-m52.blocco: Ghisa (M50, M52 North American); aluminium Nikasil (M52), cast iron rods (M52TÜ)
punti_deboli: Canne al Nikasil (M52 until 1998): Early wear with high sulphur gasoline
Cooling: water pump, radiator, thermostat and plastic expansion vase
VANOS unit: internal seals worn with high mileage, with loss of torque to average regimes
Minimum valve and butterfly sensor: minimum irregular
curiosita: The M52 was in the Ward's 10 Best Engines ranking from 1997 to 2000.
The M50B24 from 2394 cc (84 × 72 mm) was sold only in Thailand and in some Asian markets and Oceania.

versioni.nota: Double VANOS, aspiration DISA, cast iron rods

in_breve.testo: from September 1992 on the M50TÜ, first BMW variable beaming, on the only suction shaft
M52 aluminum base rods, replaced by cast iron rods since 1998
M52B28 from 193 CV, the highest displacement of the family

affidabilita.motivo: Canne Nikasil until 1998 and plastic cooling.

bmw-s50-s52.storia: BMW Motorsport's S50B30 comes from the M50 and adds six single butterfly bodies, VANOS to the 10.8:1 suction and compression for 286 hp at 7000 rpm. In 1995 the S50B32 brought the displacement to 3201 cc with alege of 86,4 and 91 mm stroke and introduces the double VANOS, with 321 CV to 7400 rpm. For the North American market BMW used simplified versions with 243 CVs: the S50B30US and, since 1996, the S52 on cast iron base of the M52 with single VANOS. It was replaced by S54 in 2000.
bmw-s50-s52.limiti: There are no documented processing thresholds from reliable sources. The cast iron base is common to all versions; the critical component on the S50B32 is the high pressure double VANOS unit, sensitive to quality and oil level.
bmw-s50-s52.distribuzione: Chain DOHC; Single VANOS (S50B30, S52), double VANOS (S50B32)
bmw-s50-s52.iniezione: Indirect; six single butterflies on European S50s
punti_deboli: VANOS unit: gaskets that drop under the operating pressure (about 100 bar), with power loss and noise
Screws of VANOS electrovalves that draw for vibration, with rapid oil loss
Valve of the minimum subject to clogging; oil filter of the VANOS to be replaced at each cutting

versioni.nota: 3152 cc, 86.4 × 89.6 mm, cast iron base M52

in_breve.testo: single butterfly bodies for cylinder on European versions
European M3 with S50, North American M3 with M50 and M52 to 243 CV

affidabilita.motivo: VANOS units with frequent faults.

bmw-s38.limiti: There are no processing thresholds documented by reliable sources; the maximum serial power is 340 CV at 6900 rpm on the S38B38. The critical component is the duplex chain distribution with thickness tips. The limiter indicated is a prudent value near the maximum power regime.
bmw-s38.iniezione: Indirect, six single butterflies, Bosch Motronic
punti_deboli: High mileage wear and tear chain tensioner
Game of valves to be checked periodically; neglect it causes irregular operation
Six butterflies to sync: without registration the minimum becomes irregular
Oil leaks from the shore cover, cup and countercoils; deteriorated vacuum tubes

single butterfly bodies powered by a molten aluminum plenum
in the M5 E34 3.8 with S38B38 from 3795 cc

affidabilita.motivo: Chain, valve game and butterflies require regular maintenance.

bmw-n47.storia: Four common rail diesel cylinders that replace the M47, with distribution chain moved on the flywheel side and variable geometry turbine; the biturbo version uses two series turbochargers. It was mounted on much of the four-cylinder BMW range, on the second generation MINI and, as the WW family, on European Toyota models. In 2014 he was replaced by B47.
bmw-n47.limiti: The 177–184 CV mono-turbo versions only earn 30–40 CVs. The critical component is the distribution chain, along with the variable geometry turbine and the clutch with bi-mass flywheel.
bmw-n47.blocco: Aluminum alloy with cast iron rods
punti_deboli: Usura and breakage of the rear distribution chain and the curtainr, more frequent on the engines produced between March 2007 and January 2009; the first symptom is a metallic noise from the gear side
Replacement of the chain requiring disassembly of the engine; the pinion is obtained on the motor shaft
Carbon deposits in the suction manifold linked to the EGR and clogging of the particulate filter in short routes
curiosita: The Toyota 1WW engines (1.6 liters, 112 CV) and 2WW (2.0 liters, 143 CV) come directly from the N47.
In 2015 BMW started a call to replace the chain tensioner and, if worn, the chain itself.

versioni.nota: 1598 cc, 78 x 83,6 mm; also 116 CV / 260 Nm

in_breve.testo: distribution chain on the side fly, accessible only by disassembling the engine
the 123d of 2007 was the first diesel series over 100 CVs per liter
capacity 1598 cc (N47D16) and 1995 cc (N47D20)

affidabilita.motivo: Rear distribution chain: widespread breaks, disassembled motor replacement.

bmw-n55.limiti: With turbo series and control unit, you can reach 380–400 CVs, plus turbo boosted, intercooler and low-pressure fuel pump. The M2 versions adopt forged motor shaft and pistons from the S55.
punti_deboli: Electric water pump, frequent failure on the first specimens (2010–2012)
Oil leaks from oil filter support seal and tip lid
Oil vapor separator (PCV) integrated into the tip cover, with expensive replacement
Carbon deposits on intake valves due to direct injection
curiosita: Alpina has built on the base N55 biturbo versions up to 440 CV and 660 Nm.

in_breve.testo: BorgWarner twin-scroll instead of the two N54 turbos
first six cylinder turbo BMW with variable valve lift
in M2 (F87), with shaft and pistons derived from S55

affidabilita.motivo: Electric water pump, PCV and oil leaks.

bmw-s63.limiti: The practical limit is thermal: the turbos in the V require a very push cooling management. With a single control unit, the F90 versions are significantly higher than the 700 CVs; they become standard and change turbocharger critics.
bmw-s63.distribuzione: Chain DOHC, double VANOS; Valvetronic from S63TU
punti_deboli: Oil consumption from about 50,000 km per incrustations in the hollows of elastic bands
Hardening of valve oil
Heat in the engine compartment that reduces battery life, especially in warm climates

BMW M engine overcharged and with direct injection (X5 M, X6 M of 2009)
in the M5 CS (F90) of 2021

bmw-s62.limiti: Suctioned motor already with high specific efficiency: with exhaust and control the earnings are contained. Consistent increases require oversupply; critical components are biella bronzes and VANOS units.
bmw-s62.iniezione: Indirect multipoint, Siemens MSS 52, eight single butterflies
punti_deboli: VANOS unit: electrovalves, seals and gear bearings, with minimal irregularity and power drop
Use of high mileage biella bronzines
Plastic chain runners, to be replaced in advance around 160,000 km
Oil leaks from the puncture cover seal, cup and filter holder

The eight butterflies are operated electronically and the driver can choose between two accelerator response maps.

electronically controlled single butterfly bodies with normal map and sport
6600 rpm with 500 Nm at 3800 rpm

bmw-m70-s70.distribuzione: Chain SOHC for bank, hydraulic props
bmw-m70-s70.iniezione: Indirect multipoint, two Bosch Motronic power stations
punti_deboli: Spinterogenes and rotary brushes subject to wear, with loss of power and increased consumption
Step-by-step butterflies motors that generate EML system errors
Oil leak from the top cover of the distribution on the first engines
curiosita: The 850CSi was produced in 1510 units and was not approved for the US market.

in_breve.testo: V12 BMW series, presented on 750 E32 in 1987
two independent Motronic systems, one per bank, with electronic accelerator EML
850CSi with the S70B56 from 5576 cc

bmw-b48.storia: Four turbo cylinders of the BMW modular family, with 500 cc per cylinder like the B38 and the B58 and many parts in common. Close-deck base in aluminium, a twin-scroll turbo with air-water intercoolers, double VANOS and Valvetronic; the version with displacement 1597 cc uses a reduced stroke at 75.6 mm. Mounted first on the Mini F56 in 2014 and from 2015 on the front and rear BMWs, as well as on Toyota GR Supra 2.0 and Morgan Plus Four. The TU series of 2018 introduces distribution chain in one piece, separate cooling circuits for head and base, biella and forged motor shaft and injection at 350 bar.
bmw-b48.limiti: Indicatively, versions 2.0 gain 50–150 CV depending on the changes; the first critical components are the plastic supercharging tube and the standard turbo, then heat management.
bmw-b48.distribuzione: Chain DOHC, double VANOS and Valvetronic
bmw-b48.iniezione: Direct, 200 bar (350 bar from TU series)
punti_deboli: Oil filter support (under suction manifold) subject to cracks, with oil leaks or cooling liquid
Electric water pump and cooling liquid return tube
Carbon deposits on intake valves, typical of direct injection
curiosita: In the United States, the low-emission version ONEV takes the B46 acronym.
On the Mini Cooper S the overboost function temporarily increases the pair of 20 Nm, up to 300 Nm.

Engine shaft and reinforced bench bearings, compression 9.5:1

bmw-b47-b57.limiti: Indicatively, the B47 earns 30–50 CVs with a single control unit; besides, they serve intercoolers and turbos increased, and the four cylinders have margins below the six cylinders.
bmw-b47-b57.iniezione: Direct common rail, up to 2500–2700 bar
punti_deboli: Valve and radiator EGR; in 2018 BMW has recalled about 1.6 million diesel produced between 2010 and 2017 for internal liquid losses in the radiator EGR
Antiparticulate filter that is inlaid with predominantly urban use
Turbocharger subject to wear if oil change intervals are not respected

The B57 also features the Ineos Grenadier off-road, with a calibration reduced to 249 CV.

alesage and running common to the four cylinders B47 and the six cylinders B57

mercedes-m117-m119.distribuzione: SOHC per bankta (M117), DOHC with suction phase variator (M119), double chain

mercedes-m104.storia: Six cylinders in line with cast iron base, aluminium head with two camshafts and four valves per cylinder, with phase variator on the aspiration; it happens to the M103 of which it maintains the intersection of 97 mm. Produced in 2,8, 3.0 and 3.2 liters with KE-Jetronic injection, then LH-Jetronic and HFM, on W124, R129, W140, W202 and W210 until the arrival of V6 M112 in 1997. The C 36 AMG of 1993, the first joint project Mercedes-Benz and AMG, brings the displacement to 3606 cc with 92.4 mm stroke and diesel engine shaft.
mercedes-m104.limiti: Indicatively the aspired versions earn 20–35 CVs with control unit and discharge; aspiring spind preparations arrive at 320–370 CVs with injectors and cooling as limits. turbo kits such as Turbo Technics have exceeded 300 CVs; automatic series change is the critical component above 300 CVs.
punti_deboli: Engine cabling with biodegradable insulation on cars 1993–1995, due to sensor and control faults
Gasket of the head with oil piping on the first units
Plastic distribution chain trays and curtains on high mileage specimens
Electronic butterfly actuator and cooling plastic components
curiosita: Of the C 36 AMG approximately 5,221 were built until 1997, when it was replaced by the C 43 AMG V8.
Versions 2.8, 3.2 and 3.6 liters of M104 were used by SsangYong on Chairman and Rexton.

the AMG version of C 36 and E 36
cylinder interassess maintained by M103

mercedes-m112-m113.limiti: Indicatively, the M113 Kompressor arrives at 530–560 CVs with reduced and central pulleys and about 600–640 CVs with increased intercoolers and injectors; over 650 CVs are critical the automatic five-speed gearbox and the heat management of the compressor.
punti_deboli: Plastic compressor joint (Kompressor versions) which can break with sudden loss of super power
Oil-air separator of the base: with wear increase oil consumption and smoke
Cooling plastic components ( thermostat box, pipes, tray) that harden with age
Gaskets of propeller lids with oil in the wells of damaged candles and coils

From the M113 Kompressor comes the Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren M155.

mercedes-m275-m279.storia: V12 to 60° biturbo that since 2002 replaces the M137 suction on S 600, CL 600 and 600 SL. It maintains a camshaft in the head for bank, three valves and two cylinder candles, with air-water intercoolers and injection in the collector; in the M275 there is no change in phase. The AMG version of 6.0 liters has increased alesage and stroke (82.6 × 93 mm) and since 2012 evolves into the M279, still used by the Maybach S 680, while the Pagani receives the M158 variant from AMG.
mercedes-m275-m279.limiti: On the AMG the torque is already limited in factory to 1000 Nm to protect the transmission: the gearbox is the critical component before the engine in case of increased pressure of oversupply.
mercedes-m275-m279.distribuzione: SOHC for Double Roller Chain Bank
punti_deboli: Double distribution chain: stretching with high routes, indicating more than 200,000 km
curiosita: The M285 for Maybach 57 and 62 comes from M275, with 551 CVs in 5.5 liters and up to 640 CVs in the 6.0 liters Zeppelin.

mercedes-m120.limiti: Suctioned motor: without internal changes the power increases are contained. The AMG versions of 7.1 and 7.3 liters require specific alesing and running, then motor shaft and barrels different from the 6.0 liters of series.
mercedes-m120.distribuzione: DOHC for double chain bank, suction variator
punti_deboli: Electronic Butterfly Engine and Cable Wiring (ETA): Degraded insulation, with EGAS power station failures
curiosita: From the M120 comes the M297 of the CLK GTR (1997); for the 25 road cars of the FIA homologation the displacement was brought to 6.9 liters.

NOx sensors on BlueTEC versions: frequent faults

mercedes-m274-m264.storia: Four turbo cylinders in aluminium with direct injection piezo, longitudinal variant for rear traction of the M270 family: 1.6 and above all 2.0 liters, with phase variators on both trees. Since 2017 the M264 replaces it with twin-scroll turbo, particulate filter, CAMTRONIC and compression 10,5:1, in some versions with 48 V system; it also exists in version 1.5 liters with reduced aleage. The 2.0-liter M274 was supplied to Infiniti for Q50 and Q60.
mercedes-m274-m264.limiti: Indicatively, the 245–258 CV versions reach 280–300 CVs with the sole control unit; the critical component is the standard turbo, along with the aspiring air temperature.
mercedes-m274-m264.distribuzione: Chain DOHC, phase variators on suction and exhaust; CAMTRONIC on M264

curiosita: The M274 for Infiniti has been produced since June 2014 in the Nissan plant in Decherd, Tennessee.

mercedes-m256.storia: Six cylinders in line that replaces the V6 M276 and is the first six in line to Mercedes gasoline after the M104. Twin-scroll turbocharger in series with an auxiliary electric compressor powered at 48 V, which provides pressure before the turbo enters into operation. The integrated starter-generator (ISG) between engine and gearbox adds 10–16 kW in acceleration, recovers braking energy and allows the engine off; water pump and climate compressor are electric, so the engine does not have a belt of accessories.
mercedes-m256.limiti: Indicatively, the control unit only carries the AMG 53 versions beyond the 450 CVs; with intercoolers and suction you will reach about 500 CVs. Beyond this threshold the critical component indicated is the automatic transmission 9G-Tronic.
mercedes-m256.distribuzione: Chain DOHC on the side fly

From 2021 the engine also equipped the Aston Martin DBX Straight-Six, sold initially only in China.

audi-ea839.storia: V6 to 90° with drains inside the V, where there are the turbo twin-scroll of 3.0 or the two turbos of 2.9. Adopt Audi's B cycle: partial load the suction valves close in advance, while at high load the AVS system brings the rise from 6 to 10 mm and the duration to 200° crank. The 2.9 biturbo has reduced stroke of 3 mm (86 mm) and replaces the 4.2 V8 FSI on RS4 and RS5; in the distribution of the group the development of the V6 gasoline is up to Audi and the motor is also used by Porsche.
audi-ea839.limiti: Indicatively, the unit only adds about 60 CVs and 180 Nm to 2.9 biturbo and about 40 CVs and 100 Nm to 3.0 monoturbo. For superior powers become critical high-pressure fuel pump and intercooler.

vw-ea111-14-tsi-twincharger.storia: Four cylinders of the EA111 family with grey cast iron base, direct injection and dual superpower, presented at the Frankfurt Motor Show in 2005 and mounted by the Golf GT TSI. A Roots Eaton volumetric compressor operated by magnetic clutch works at the low series regimes at the KKK turbocharger, which takes over more than 2400 rpm; a butterfly valve handles the passage between the two. The 122 and 131 CV versions of the same family only have the turbo and do not fall into this card; the successor is the E211 1.4 TSI, only turbo.
vw-ea111-14-tsi-twincharger.limiti: Indicatively the 160–180 CV versions accept moderate mapping; the critical component is the series pistons, sensitive to detonation, followed by the distribution chain. Those who process the engine must first exclude missing hints and oil consumption.
punti_deboli: Distribution chain: stretching and transfer of the hydraulic tendicatena
Water pump and magnetic compressor clutch, mounted on the same group: low torque loss or overheating
High oil consumption on some units, solved in workshop with new segments
curiosita: He won the International Engine of the Year as the best new engine in 2006 and category 1.0–1,4 liters from 2006 to 2011.
In 2011 the press reported that Volkswagen would abandon the dual superpower because it was too expensive to produce on a engine of this displacement.

vw-ea288.storia: Family of three and four-cylinder diesel (1,4, 1.6 and 2.0 liters) that since 2012 replaces the EA189, of which it preserves alesage and run of 2.0 (81,0 × 95.5 mm). It has been developed for Euro 6 standards, with recirculation of low-pressure gases cooled and mounting both transverse and longitudinal. The evo update, presented in 2019 with the Golf VIII, brings injectors up to nine injections per cycle, 2200 bar, two balancing trees from 150 CV versions and the twin dosing system; in Golf VIII 1.6 TDI is replaced by a reduced power 2.0.
vw-ea288.limiti: Indicatively, 150 CV versions reach 180–190 CV with only mapping; critical components are turbo and friction (or DSG change). Evo versions have a more complex post-treatment that limits changes.
vw-ea288.iniezione: Direct common rail, up to 2200 bars on the evo

The 2.0 BiTDI of Passat B8 combines two turbochargers on a four-cylinder series, with 500 Nm.

in_breve.testo: family debut replacing EEA189 for Euro 6 standards

vw-w12.storia: Twelve cylinders obtained by joining two VR6 pallets on a single motor shaft arranged at 72° each. In each bankta the six cylinders are in turn staggered by 15° on two rows, so the engine has four rows of three cylinders and slightly exceeds 50 cm in length; the shaft has pins of 12° staggered biella for bursts every 60°. Debutta aspirated on Audi A8 and Volkswagen Phaeton, then in biturbo version since 2003 on the Bentley Continental GT, hand-made at Crewe until April 2024. The third generation (2015, Bentayga) has more rigid base than 30%, direct and indirect injection and deactivation of six cylinders.
vw-w12.limiti: Bentley biturbs come in series at 710–750 CVs and over 1000 Nms with the same base; beyond these values, indicatively, the limits are turbochargers, air cooling over power and change.
vw-w12.distribuzione: DOHC for bank, chains on the fly side, variable intake and unloading
vw-w12.iniezione: Indirect; direct on FSI 6.3; direct and indirect on Bentleys since 2015
curiosita: In 2002 a Volkswagen W12 prototype set speed records on 24 hours on the Nardò track.
Bentley built in Crewe over 100,000 W12; each engine required approximately 6.5 hours of hand mounting.

vw-ea211-15-tsi-evo.storia: Evolution of the four EA211 cylinders presented in April 2016 at the Vienna Motor Symposium, with an extended stroke of 85.9 mm compared to 1.4 TSI. Combine Miller cycle with compression up to 12.5:1, variable geometry turbocharger, direct injection at 350 bar, plasma retractable barrels and central cylinder deactivation (ACT). The evo2 of 2022, starting from the T-Roc, integrates catalyst and particulate filter into a single module near the engine, pistons with cooling channels and ACTplus management, and is the basis of the mild hybrid and plug-in versions of the group.

porsche-930-carrera-32.storia: Evolution of the six-cylinder air-cooled boxer and 911 SC oil, with an increase of 4 mm to 95 mm and engine shaft of the 911 Turbo 3.3, for 3164 cc; according to Porsche about 80% of the components was redesigned. K-Jetronic mechanical injection gives way to Bosch Motronic (DME) electronic management, with release power cut, and distribution adopts hydraulic chain tensioners. Equip 911 Carrera from 1984 to 1989, in a European version without catalyst and in catalyzed versions with reduced compression for USA, Canada and Japan.

The 9A2 Evo evolution of 992 introduces a new combustion process with piezoelectric injectors in a central position and revived turbochargers; Porsche indicates 9A2 and 9A2 Evo as the basis of all four and six-cylinder boxers in production since 2020. In the 992 Turbo and Turbo S the displacement rises to 3745 cc with 102 mm alesge and variable geometry turbochargers.

The 992.2 GTS T-Hybrid and the 992.2 Turbo S adopt a different 3.6 liters from 97 × 81 mm with electrical assistance, not included in this card.

porsche-718-boxer-4.storia: Four-cylinder boxer overcharged that in 2016 replaces the six aspired cylinders of Boxster and Cayman, obtained from the 9A2 biturb boxer family of 911 with two cylinders less. The 2.0 has axle and stroke of 3.0 liters to six cylinders; the 2.5 carries the 102 mm axle and adopts a variable geometry turbocharger with wastegate. Direct injection with central injector near the candle and VarioCam Plus with variable lift also on the discharge. The production of 718 gasoline, with which the engine came out, ended in October 2025.
porsche-718-boxer-4.limiti: Extended processing is mainly centralized; the critical components indicated for larger increases are turbochargers and intercoolers. Documented thresholds are not available from the manufacturer.
porsche-718-boxer-4.distribuzione: DOHC, VarioCam Plus on suction and exhaust

porsche-m48.storia: V8 at 90° developed for the first Cayenne, with four valves per cylinder, VarioCam variable beaming and dry casing lubrication; the biturb versions have two parallel turbochargers and forged pistons with cooling oil jets. In 2007 the allocation passes from 93 to 96 mm, the displacement to 4806 cc and arrives the direct injection with VarioCam Plus. Since 2009 he has also equipped the Panamera, whose lightened biturb version has passed on the Cayenne less than a year later.
porsche-m48.limiti: On the biturb versions, the reappearance is the most widespread intervention; beyond the standard Turbo S powers, the critical components are turbochargers, air cooling of super power and change. There are no documented thresholds from the manufacturer.
punti_deboli: Cylinder refills on the aspired versions, more frequent on 4.5, related to overheating, cold use and lubrication

porsche-m44.storia: Four cylinders in line designed by Porsche for 944, which resumes from the V8 of the 928 inter axis of the cylinders, concept of the headboard, valves, springs and props; the aluminum-silicon alloy base has no reeds. To contain the vibrations of a 2.5 litre four-cylinder, it adopts two counterrotating contralbers on a Mitsubishi patent. The displacement rises to 2.7 and 3.0 liters, with 16 valve heads from 944 S and VarioCam variable beaming on 968; the Turbo version has intercoolers and forged pistons.
porsche-m44.limiti: On the 944 Turbo the pressure increases of superpower are the most widespread intervention; the critical components are the seal of the head and turbocharger. There are no documented thresholds from the manufacturer. Suctioned versions offer limited margins.
porsche-m44.distribuzione: SOHC belt (8 valves); DOHC belt and chain (16 valves), VarioCam on 968

Oil-water exchanger gaskets: oil mixing and coolant liquid
Water pump, operated by the distribution belt

The VarioCam debuted on 968 in 1991 before switching to 911 boxers (993).

porsche-m28.storia: First V8 series Porsche cooled to water, designed for 928 with base and almost entirely tested in light alloy and cylinders without reeds. Born in two valves per cylinder with a camshaft for bank and power supply K-Jetronic, it passed in 1985 to four valves and two shafts per bankta. The displacement grows from 4.5 to 5.0 liters and, with the stretched stroke to 85.9 mm, to 5.4 liters on the GTS, the latest version produced until 1995.
porsche-m28.limiti: Aspirated margins are limited. Consistent increases pass for aftermarket compressor kits, with power plant and cooling as critical components.
porsche-m28.distribuzione: SOHC for belt bank; DOHC since 1985 with belt and chain (suction)
punti_deboli: Deployment strap and tensioner: periodic replacement required, breakage on the 32 valve versions damages valves
Motor shaft mount: marked wear on the S4 and GT with automatic gearbox
Costly specific spare parts, main cause of high maintenance costs
curiosita: The four cylinders of 944 resume from the V8 of 928 inter axis of cylinders, valves, springs and props.

opel-x20xev.storia: Four 16-valve bi-tree cylinders from the GM Family II family, heir of large series of the C20XE with the same cast iron base and the same square measurements. The headboard is redesigned with an angle between the tightest valves to promote the torque to the medium-low regimes at the expense of the maximum power (136 CV versus 150). For Euro 2 standards it adopts recirculation of exhaust gases (EGR) and secondary air injection to warm the catalyst more quickly.
punti_deboli: Exhaust collector in cast iron subject to crack
Irregular minimum or base ventilation regulator dirt

curiosita: In 16V versions of Calibra and Vectra took the place of the C20XE with Cosworth head, renouncing 14 CVs but with couple more available to low regimes.

ford-ecoboost-20-23.storia: Four direct injection turbo cylinders derived from Duratec HE, in turn based on the Mazda MZR (L series): aluminum base and headboard, chain distribution and variable beaming on both trees (Ti-VCT). The 2.0 debuted in 2010 on Ford, Volvo and Land Rover; in 2015 it arrives 2.3, obtained by stretching the race from 83.1 to 94.0 mm to equal alege and equipped with twin-scroll turbo. On the Focus RS Mk3 2.3 it has alloy head for higher temperatures, reinforced sealing, more resistant cast iron rods and turbo with increased compressor.
ford-ecoboost-20-23.limiti: With only mapping 2.3 earned 10–20 %. Over 400 CVs, with turbo increased, the trainers replace standard pistons and biellas with forged components; the seal of the head is the critical component.
punti_deboli: Head gasket on the first Focus RS Mk3: cooling and overheating infiltration
Carbon deposits on intake valves, typical of direct injection
Overheating on the first 2.3 specimens for missing thermal screens
curiosita: The Focus RS Mk3 was assembled in Saarlouis, Germany; the 2.3 engine is produced in Valencia and Brook Park (Ohio).

ford-voodoo-predator.limiti: The Voodoo earns about 50 hp with only mapping; to overpower it the limit is compression 12,0:1. The Predator with increased compressor exceeds 1000 CVs; at those levels they become critical fuel supply, compressed air cooling and serial internal organs.

psa-dw10.storia: Four diesel cylinders with cast iron base and aluminium head, introduced in 1999 instead of the XUD9: it is the first PSA engine with direct common rail injection, initially with Bosch CP1 pump and about 1350 bar. The DW10BTED4 switches to 16 valves and turbo variable geometry; Ford and Volvo adopt it as 2.0 TDCi and 2.0D. The DW10F Euro 6 versions with SCR are still mounted on average Stellantis commercial vehicles in 2026.
psa-dw10.limiti: The 16-valve versions with variable geometry turbo accept moderate mappings; turbocharger, bi-mass flywheel and clutch are the first components to suffer when the torque rises beyond the standard values (up to 400 Nm in the DW10FC and 450 Nm in the Ford biturbo).

Siemens tandem pump and pressure regulator filter on the first versions
curiosita: The DW10 shares alesaggio and corsa (85 × 88 mm) with EW10 gasoline from the same EW/DW family.

psa-eb2.storia: Three 1.2 litre cylinders with aluminium base, presented in 2012 in aspired version (produced to Trémery) and since 2014 in direct injection turbo version (Douvrin, then also China and Tychy). Until 2022 the distribution uses a toothed belt that works immersed in the engine oil; the third generation of 2023 passes to the chain and is the base of the hybrid versions to 48 V. From 2026 Peugeot mounts on 208 and 2008 the Turbo 100, a 1.2 three cylinders revised with chain, Miller cycle and turbo with variable geometry.
psa-eb2.distribuzione: DOHC belt in oil bath, chained by Gen3 (2023)

Oil dilution with fuel and high oil consumption on turbos
Carbon deposits on injectors and valves of direct injection versions

renault-f7r.storia: Four cylinders of the F family with cast iron base and 16-valve aluminium bi-tree head, with belt distribution. It comes from the F7P 1.8 liters of the Renault 19 16S: for the F7R the allocation passes from 82 to 82,7 mm and the race from 83,5 to 93 mm, with larger valves and profiles of the most pushed cams. Debuted in 1993 on Clio Williams with integrated management Fenix 3A, then equipped the Mégane Coupé 16V and the Renault Sport Spider; the last job is on the Russian Moskvitch 2142 until 2001.
renault-f7r.limiti: Indicative thresholds. The Clio Williams Maxi rally versions reached 250–275 CVs with complete preparation and, in later evolutions, reduced racing shaft (90 mm) with alesaggio 84 mm to stay in 1998 cc. The long run of series (93 mm) makes the tree-bielle group the critical component when raising the regime beyond the standard values.
punti_deboli: Extended distribution strap or with a jumped tooth: minimum unstable and power loss
curiosita: In BTCC the Williams Lagoon used an F7R prepared by Sodemo, up to about 320 CVs in aspired version.
The 1993 Clio Williams was produced in 3800 numbered specimens, then flanked by additional series for about 12,600 total units.

renault-f4r.storia: Four cylinders of the F family with cast iron base without reeds, tested in 16 valve aluminum with hydraulic props and phase variator on the suction camshaft. It maintains alesaggio and race of the F7R (82,7 × 93 mm) and has been used both aspirated, on the series Renaults and on the RS Clios up to 203 CVs, and is overwhelmed as F4Rt with twin-scroll Mitsubishi. On the Mégane RS the F4Rt works with 8.6:1 compression, sodium-cooled exhaust valves and up to 2.5 bar power supply.
renault-f4r.distribuzione: DOHC belt, phase variator on suction

prv-v6.storia: V6 to 90° with aluminium base and headboards, built by Française de Mécanique in Douvrin for the consortium between Peugeot, Renault and Volvo. It originates from a project V8 reduced to six cylinders after the oil crisis, from which the angle of 90° that in the first series (1974–1985) produces irregular ignition intervals. Since 1984, with the Renault 25 V6 Turbo, the staggered crank pins make regular breaks; the standard displacements range from 2458 to 2975 cc, aspired or over-charged, with 12 or 24 valve heads. Since 1994 it has been replaced by the V6 ES/L of PSA and Renault and the production ends on 15 June 1998.
prv-v6.iniezione: Carburetors, then indirect injection (Bosch LH-Jetronic on some versions)
curiosita: In 1988 the WM P88 with V6 PRV overcharged reached 407 km/h on the straight of the Huudières in Le Mans.
The Renault Safrane Biturbo, developed with Hartge and Irmscher, was produced in 806 from 1994 to 1996.

volvo-modulare-l5.storia: Five turbo cylinders from the Volvo modular family, built in Skövde from 1990 to 2016 with aluminum block and headboard and twenty valves. The first turbo is 2.3 liters (81 x 90 mm) of 850 T5 for the model year 1994; since 2003 the main displacement passes to 2521 cc with race of 93.2 mm, and the last B5254T12 evolution of 2497 cc remains on the T5 until 2016. Ford uses it as Duratec ST and Duratec RS on the second series Focus: the RS has reduced compression to 8,5:1, reinforced biella and turbo K16 with 1,37 bar maximum pressure.
volvo-modulare-l5.limiti: The RS500 delivers 350 CVs and 460 Nm with the same internal components as the 305 CV RS (belts, pistons, barrels with spray, magazine head gasket). On versions 2.3 litres of 850 the critical component are the biellas; beyond the power of the R versions they serve accurate control of the super power pressure and increased turbo.
punti_deboli: Ventilation of the base (PCV, flame trap): if the internal pressure is clogged the oil from the rear oil of the shaft
850 T5 and R rods: can bend if the oversupply pressure control valve fails or is adjusted badly
Oil consumption on 2.5 liters of model year 2013–2016, the subject of a class action in the United States for shave rings
curiosita: Of the 850 T-5R, sold as such in 1995 and then in a second series in 1996, were produced 6964 specimens.
The Focus RS500 was built in Saarlouis in 500 copies numbered since May 2010.

volvo-vea.storia: Four cylinders of the VEA modular family (Volvo Engine Architecture), which includes three and four petrol and diesel cylinders and replaced the five and six Volvo cylinders. The first cars with these engines, S60 and V60, are delivered in autumn 2013; production takes place in Skövde, since 2016 also in Zhangjiakou in China and from 2022 at Proton in Malaysia. The most powerful versions combine a Roots volumetric compressor with the turbocharger, and the same base equips T8 plug-in hybrids, Polestars and Lynk & Co models.
volvo-vea.limiti: The B4204T43 Polestar comes standard at 367 CV and 470 Nm with compression reduced to 8,6:1 and is the reference for the load born from the engine. The maximum declared VEA gas station is 6000 rpm.

curiosita: In double-supply versions the volumetric compressor provides the push to the low regimes and the turbocharger intervenes over about 3000 rpm.

toyota-2gr.storia: V6 to 60° with open-deck die-cast aluminium base and chain distribution on two stages: a primary chain commands suction shafts, two secondary chains that are discharged. Debuted in 2005 on Toyota Avalon as 2GR- EF indirect injection and, in the same year, as 2GR- ESF with D-4S injection on Lexus GS 350 and IS 350. Since 2015 the 2GR-FKS combines D-4S and VVT-iW suction beam with simulated Atkinson cycle operation; Lotus has been using it since 2009, even with volumetric compressor.
toyota-2gr.limiti: Lotus versions with compressor come standard at 430 CV and 440 Nm, indication of the internal organ seal at those levels. Besides, the open-deck base and the seal of the head become the points to be evaluated; higher values should be considered with caution.

toyota-2gr.iniezione: Indirect multipoint (FE); Direct D-4S + Indirect (FSE, FKS)

toyota-1kd-1gd.storia: The 1KD-FTV, 3.0 liters common rail D-4D with variable geometry turbo and two balance trees, debuted in 2000 on the Japanese Land Cruiser Prado. In 2015 the KD family is replaced by the GD: the 1GD-FTV from 2.8 liters passes to the distribution chain, lowers the compression to 15.6:1 and brings the injection pressure to 220 MPa. Since 2020 the updated version has been up to 204 CVs and since August 2023 is also available with mild hybrid 48 V. The main technical data of the card refer to the 1GD-FTV.
toyota-1kd-1gd.limiti: On 1KD-FTV the change of the control unit is not recommended for the risk of cracks in the pistons. The 1GD-FTV reaches 224 CV and 550 Nm on cast iron base; additional increases stress friction, manual change (limited to 420 Nm of series) and particle filter. Sealing values beyond series values are not documented.
toyota-1kd-1gd.iniezione: Direct common rail Denso (up to 220 MPa on 1GD-FTV, 250 MPa since 2020)
punti_deboli: 1KD-FTV: copper sealing washers of injectors (2005–2007) that let the gas pass in the tip lid, with carbonized oil and oyster cup fishery
1KD-FTV: Injector failures, often between 120,000 and 140.000 km
1GD-FTV: incomplete regeneration of the particle filter with intaxation (P2463 code), subject to software updates and collective action in Australia
1GD-FTV: Injector nozzle deposits and internal cracks in the EGR radiator
curiosita: The 1GD-FTV injectors have a QR code with the individual flow correction, to be programmed in the control unit to replace.

toyota-2ur-gse.storia: High performance version of the UR family V8 5.0, developed for the Lexus IS F. The high flow heads are designed by Yamaha, with titanium suction valves, increased camshafts, two length suction manifold and D-4S injection. The maximum regimen has risen from 6800 to 7300 rpm in later versions; it has never been combined with a manual series change. According to communications to the dealers reported by the press, the production ends with LC 500 in August 2026.

nissan-ca18det.storia: Four turbo cylinders of the CA series with cast iron base and new 16-valve aluminium bi-pole headboard, the latest AC engine introduced. Cross mounted on Auster and Bluebird ATTESA and longitudinally on Silvia, 180SX and 200SX. The latest Japanese versions have an 8-phase intake head with secondary butterflies, the European ones one to 4.

honda-j35-j37.storia: The J35 is the 3.5 litres of the J series, the fourth family of V6 Honda with 60° stands, produced in the plants of Anna (Ohio) and Lincoln (Alabama). He debuted on the 1999 Odyssey with single-shaft headboards and VTEC; since 2005 he adopted the deactivation of VCM cylinders and since 2014 direct injection. The J37 from 3664 cc (2007–2014) has increased alesage and stroke and magnesium alloy suction manifold. In 2023, Pilot's J35Y8 went to two-shaft heads without VTEC.

skoda-ea111-12-htp.storia: The EA111 1.2 HTP family is a three-cylinder petrol engine developed in Mladá Boleslav and produced from 2001. The first 40 kW version reached the Fabia in 2002, followed by the 12-valve variant in 2003. It features an aluminium block and cylinder head, a balance shaft and chain-driven valve gear, in SOHC and DOHC configurations. In 2014 Škoda announced that three million units had been produced.
punti_deboli: The hydraulic timing-chain tensioner may lose tension while the engine is stopped; chain jumping and rattling have been documented on some versions.
Early versions can experience high temperatures near the catalytic converter, affecting lubrication; later revisions introduced heat shielding.
skoda-ea111-12-htp.limiti: There is insufficient comparable evidence to establish a safe tuning power limit for standard internal components. Timing-chain condition, cooling and lubrication should be checked before performance modifications.
curiosita: In 2014 Škoda reported production of three million 1.2 HTP engines.
The 6-valve SOHC version preceded the 12-valve DOHC version.
manutenzione: Check for timing-chain noise during cold starts; replacement procedures depend on the engine code.
Follow the vehicle-specific service manual for oil and filter intervals; do not apply one generic interval to every variant.
